chippewa-nf-boundary.geojson.query: FORESTNAME = 'Chippewa National Forest' on BdyAdm_LSRS_AdministrativeForest (112 features); GDB downloaded 2026-11-21, converted with GDAL
chippewa-nf-boundary.geojson.caveats: USFS Enterprise Data Warehouse (EDW) download route -- the live EDW ArcGIS service (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcgis/rest/services/EDW/EDW_ForestSystemBoundaries_01/MapServer) returns HTTP 403 from this VM, so no live-service clipped count was obtainable. Downloaded AdministrativeForest GDB (https://data.fs.usda.gov/geodata/edw/edw_resources/fc/BdyAdm_LSRS_AdministrativeForest.gdb.zip) -- 'Administrative Forest Boundaries', the downloadable equivalent of the ForestSystemBoundaries proclaimed-boundary dataset -- and filtered to FORESTNAME='Chippewa National Forest' (1 of 112 national-forest features). Source CRS NAD83 lon/lat. Full proclaimed-boundary extent kept (8 polygons, 3,215 vertices); NOT clipped to HUC8. GIS_ACRES 1598138.9 (attribute) vs 1597734.2 ac measured from the geometry in UTM 15N. In-watershed overlap: 535256.1 ac of the 857971.7 ac HUC8 (62.4% of the watershed) lies inside the proclaimed boundary. Reservation overlap (measured): 741573.0 ac of 823248.6 ac Reservation geometry (90.1%) lies within the proclaimed boundary -- the synthesis's '~90% of Reservation land lies within the Forest boundary' (inventory 4.2) IS supported by the measured data.
